towelwise.hyperspace.hideActivityBar.description: Hide the activity bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideStatusBar.description: Hide the status bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideMenuBar.description: Hide the menu bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideCommandCenter.description: Hide the command palette box in the title bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideLayoutControls.description: Hide the layout buttons in the title bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hidePrimarySideBar.description: Close the primary side bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideSecondarySideBa.description: Close the secondary side bar in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.hideBottomPanel.description: Close the bottom panel in hyperspace.

towelwise.hyperspace.fullScreen.description: Also enter true full screen in hyperspace, and leave it on restore. VS Code cannot report whether the window is already full screen, so start from a windowed window.

towelwise.hyperspace.sizes.description: The widths and heights hyperspace sets, as proportions of the window from 0 to 1: the primary side bar (sidebar) and secondary side bar (auxiliarybar) widths, and the bottom panel (panel) with its orientation (panelOrientation: across when the panel is left or right, down when top or bottom). Set it from Edit Hyperspace Layout. Parts left out keep their size.

towelwise.hyperspace.editorGrid.description: The editor area's columns and rows that hyperspace re-applies: orientation (0 for columns, 1 for rows) and groups, each with a size as a proportion of its parent, an optional label for the picker, and optional nested groups. Set it with Use current layout in Edit Hyperspace Layout. It only changes proportions; it never opens, closes or moves a tab, and it is left alone if the editor area's columns and rows no longer match.

towelwise.layout.containers.markdownDescription: The agent panels to show when you restore your layout, in order. Set it with **Towelwise: Choose Layout**.

towelwise.layout.applyOnStartup.description: Also apply your layout when a window opens. Skipped while hyperspace is on.

towelwise.layout.commands.markdownDescription: Command ids to run after the containers when you run **Towelwise: Restore Layout**, in order, for panels that are not side bars (for example an agent that opens as an editor tab). Not run by apply on startup. A command that opens a new tab each time can pile up duplicates if the tab is already open.

items.patternErrorMessage: Use a command id, a prefix ending in .*, or menu: followed by a menu id.

towelwise.menus.hidden.markdownDescription: Commands to hide from the menus, the Command Palette and keyboard shortcuts. Each entry is a command id, or a prefix ending in `.*`. An entry of the form `menu:MenuId` hides the submenu item that opens that menu, such as `menu:MenubarLayoutMenu`, but not the commands inside it. Hidden commands still run when other code calls them. Empty the list to bring everything back. Needs Towelwise AI.

command.description: The command id to run when the entry is chosen.

title.description: The text shown. Put & before a letter to use it as the shortcut letter.

group.description: Entries with the same group sit together; a change of group draws a separator. Defaults to the previous entry's group.

when.description: A condition (a context-key expression). The entry shows only while it is true.

towelwise.menus.towelwise.markdownDescription: The entries of the Towelwise menu in the menu bar, in order. Each needs a `command` and a `title`; `group` separates sections and `when` shows an entry only while a condition holds. Entries with a mistake are skipped and named in the Towelwise output. Needs Towelwise AI.

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Towelwise
walkthroughs.description: Arrange your agents, choose a layout, and try hyperspace.

steps.title: Your agents
steps.description:
Towelwise works alongside any AI coding agent you already use.
No agent yet? [Open Extensions](command:workbench.view.extensions) to choose one yourself.

steps.title: Arrange your agents
steps.description: Drag each agent's panel to the side you want it on. Towelwise brings panels back; it does not move them.

steps.title: Choose your layout
steps.description:
Pick the agent panels you want showing.
[Choose Layout](command:towelwise.layout.choose)

steps.title: Bring it back anytime
steps.description:
Reopen your chosen panels after a reload, an update or a new project. Press Alt+Shift+L, or:
[Restore Layout](command:towelwise.layout.restore)

steps.title: Jump to hyperspace
steps.description:
Hide everything but your agents, then press it again to put it all back. Press Alt+Shift+J, or:
[Jump to Hyperspace](command:towelwise.hyperspace.toggle)

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description:
Choose what hyperspace hides, turn on full screen, or apply your layout when a window opens.
[Open Towelwise settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22towelwise%22%5D)
